title: Matched v101 o and A share a loop family and differ in a lower-right contour proxy
statement: A frozen practice-training roster contains 23 same-page v101 o/A pairs whose words have the same independent ZL and Takahashi EVA reading. Exact sequence alignment localizes 29 members, including 11 complete pairs on 11 Yale canvases. One recovered location adds a complete pair to the first blinded deck. The readers agree on the loop family of 29 of 30 targets and use the same exact chart reference for three targets, all in the predicted direction. Only one complete pair has two definite chart matches. The readers agree on projection presence for three A members and for zero o members. The lower-right raster projection proxy is greater for A in 10/11 strictly localized pairs and 11/12 including the first recovered pair at two contrast thresholds. The normalized median shift at the middle threshold is 0.076 glyph heights. Local slope corrections retain the direction in 10 or 11 of the 12 pairs. Two later location recoveries yield one round closed loop and one unresolved member. The small, imbalanced pilot provides directional geometric evidence and limited exact visual identifiability of the printed variants.
check: Recreate the frozen EVA-identical pairs and confirm every glyph box with the native Yale scans. Repeat with independent human annotators, stronger balanced coverage by hand and a predeclared continuous contour feature. Report family, projection and exact chart-match agreement separately with ambiguous glyphs kept in their denominators. Treat all geometry-based recoveries as sensitivities.

protocol.source_question: Zandbergen 2022, Transliteration of the Voynich MS text
protocol.contrast: Glen Claston v101 o versus capital A among matched words with the same single EVA o under independent ZL and Takahashi readings.
protocol.roster_freeze: candidates.json committed in the experiment data with its original SHA-256 before localization or morphology scoring. Include complete located pairs as the primary analysis and report every unresolved locator.
protocol.positioning: Whole-line order-preserving exact EVA word alignment to Ryan Allen's word geometry. Require that every optimal alignment assigns the target to the same donor word. Within that word require all stored glyph readings to reconstruct the common EVA string and exactly one located o. Keep a secondary location recovery separate. For paired conclusions require both matched members.
protocol.blindness: Use randomly ordered anonymous crop IDs assigned before inspection. Give each visual reader the same native word and a target detail with space around the loop. Provide unlabelled neutral reference shapes, withhold manuscript panel, transcription, stroke class, pairing and hand.

neutral_features.aperture_side: top, bottom, left, right, none, ambiguous
neutral_features.lower_right_projection: present, absent, unresolved. A free lower-right stroke visibly extends below the adjacent lower loop contour and has roughly a stroke width of clearance. If continuity, adjacent ink or fading is unclear, use unresolved.
neutral_features.neutral_reference: R1 compact rounded loop and R2 extended lower-right stroke. Readers may call unclear or neither. No forced dichotomy.

protocol.outcomes: Retain per-reader labels, exact family and variant agreement and jointly definite denominators. Test agreement with the v101 chart separately from reader agreement. Examine complete paired words and disclose the number of physical panels, hand imbalance and any artifact or uncertain positioning.
protocol.scope: The chart is a typographic reference and the manuscripts have different ink and scanning conditions. Treat model readers as a visual pilot on public practice training pages.

frozen_roster.split: public practice training only from the pinned ZL split definition
frozen_roster.selection: Certain paragraph words with exactly one GC o/A at the same position in a complete same-page GC word frame. Require equal GC/ZL/IT parsed counts on each source locus and identical certain ZL and IT words at both reparsed ordinals. Keep all matched pairs, using source encounter order without reusing occurrences. No images are consulted for selection.
frozen_roster.ordinal_limits: Equal-length line frames and matching independent words do not establish physical registration. Word ordinals refer to the Swarm parser, which splits uncertain commas. Allen readings are geometric leads only, even when an ordinal agrees. A unique or repeated EVA name requires independent whole-word location on native scans.

blind_review_notes.reader2: R1 opens upward near eleven o'clock. R2 has a closed counter and lower-right connected terminal. X10, X15, X25, and X27 have mottled apparent bridges. X12 is too faded. X24 has a definite lower gap and possible upper break. X28 has more than one possible opening. X29 has adjacent and faint ink. X04 visibly projects and has an open lower-right counter.

fixed_deck_geometry_proxy.method: Measure position of low rows with ink in the central and right bands of each located glyph's native bounding rectangle. The 93rd percentile of accepted rows on the right minus the corresponding central percentile, divided by glyph height, is an exploratory projection proxy. Three contrast fractions and every available comparison are shown. This proxy depends on the letter-coordinate crop and cannot determine pen continuity or the class.

line_inclination_sensitivity.method: Estimate local line slope from the median of all same-image word box slopes with horizontal separation at least 100 pixels. Require at least four boxes and four qualifying slopes. Subtract the estimated y change between the nominal center of the two glyph bands. Consider word-box center and bottom as two imperfect measures of row position. This is an exploratory sensitivity to writing inclination on the originally frozen deck.

evidence.scope: The fixed 30 cards include one row-based recovery and six other solitary members of incomplete pairs. The primary geometry set has two complete pairs from each of hands 1 and 2, and seven from hand 3. Printed shape agreement and a clearly free projecting stroke are different observables from lower-right ink extent. The raster estimates are exploratory and depend on the chosen local crop, its automatic letter segmentation, and thresholds. No categorical reading generalization is supported by the three definite chart assignments alone.

sources.question: https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-3313/keynote1.pdf
sources.coordinate_credits: Ryan Allen's public glyph map, CC BY 4.0. Images of Beinecke MS 408, Yale University Library.

reproduction.text_scope: Use only publish's public practice training view with pinned ZL3b-n, IT2a-n and GC2a-n files.
reproduction.geometry: Extract letters.tsv, words.tsv and pages.tsv from glyph-map.zip and check the hashes before running the exact line matcher. Rebuild the first recovery and supplementary locations using their evidence rows.

scripts_as_text.prepare_blind_deck.py:
"""Build source-masked native glyph-and-context cards."""
import argparse
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from hashlib import sha256
from io import BytesIO
import json
from pathlib import Path
import random
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
TARGET = ROOT / "blind-deck"
SEED = 527203
W, H = 323, 242
COLS, ROWS = 3, 2
BG, INK, GUIDE = (247, 245, 238), (19, 28, 37), (30, 87, 140)


def get_crop(entry):
    wx0, wy0, wx1, wy1 = entry["word_rect"]
    gx0, gy0, gx1, gy1 = entry["glyph_rect"]
    x0, y0 = max(0, min(wx0, gx0) - 12), max(0, min(wy0, gy0) - 12)
    x1, y1 = max(wx1, gx1) + 12, max(wy1, gy1) + 12
    service = entry["iiif_image"].split("/full/")[0]
    url = f"{service}/{x0},{y0},{x1-x0},{y1-y0}/full/0/default.jpg"
    cached = ROOT / "native-cache" / (sha256(url.encode()).hexdigest() + ".jpg")
    if not cached.is_file():
        request = Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Voynich Swarm masked shape audit"})
        with urlopen(request, timeout=20) as opened:
            cached.write_bytes(opened.read())
    payload = cached.read_bytes()
    scan = Image.open(BytesIO(payload)).convert("RGB")
    if scan.size != (x1-x0, y1-y0):
        raise ValueError((entry["locus"], scan.size, (x1-x0, y1-y0)))
    return scan, (x0, y0), url, sha256(payload).hexdigest()


def fitted(image, max_width, max_height, limit):
    scale = min(max_width / image.width, max_height / image.height, limit)
    return image.resize((round(image.width * scale), round(image.height * scale)), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)


def card(entry, code, fetched):
    scan, (x0, y0), url, digest = fetched
    gx0, gy0, gx1, gy1 = entry["glyph_rect"]
    a, b, c, d = gx0-x0, gy0-y0, gx1-x0, gy1-y0
    detail = scan.crop((max(0, a-9), max(0, b-9),
                        min(scan.width, c+9), min(scan.height, d+9)))
    detail = fitted(detail, 210, 127, 3.5)
    word = fitted(scan, 306, 71, 1.5)
    tile = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    pen = ImageDraw.Draw(tile)
    pen.text((10, 5), code, fill=INK)
    tile.paste(detail, ((W-detail.width)//2, 21))
    word_left = (W-word.width)//2
    word_top = 155 + (75-word.height)//2
    tile.paste(word, (word_left, word_top))
    x_mid = (a+c)/2 * word.width / scan.width + word_left
    y_mark = word_top + word.height + 1
    pen.line((x_mid, y_mark, x_mid, y_mark+6), fill=GUIDE, width=2)
    pen.line((x_mid-3, y_mark+4, x_mid, y_mark), fill=GUIDE, width=1)
    pen.line((x_mid+3, y_mark+4, x_mid, y_mark), fill=GUIDE, width=1)
    record = dict(entry, blind_code=code, native_crop_url=url, native_crop_sha256=digest)
    return tile, record


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--positions", default="geometry-frozen.json", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--workers", default=8, type=int)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    raw = json.loads(args.positions.read_text())
    chosen = [entry for entry in raw if entry["available"]]
    random.Random(SEED).shuffle(chosen)
    TARGET.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (ROOT / "native-cache").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=args.workers) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(get_crop, entry) for entry in chosen]
        tiles = []
        for slot, (entry, future) in enumerate(zip(chosen, futures, strict=True), 1):
            try:
                tile, record = card(entry, f"X{slot:02}", future.result())
            except Exception as error:
                raise RuntimeError((entry["pair_id"], entry["locus"], str(error))) from error
            tiles.append((tile, record))
    for i in range(0, len(tiles), COLS * ROWS):
        board = Image.new("RGB", (W * COLS, H * ROWS), BG)
        for j, (tile, _) in enumerate(tiles[i:i+COLS*ROWS]):
            board.paste(tile, (W * (j % COLS), H * (j // COLS)))
        board.save(TARGET / f"board-{1+i//(COLS*ROWS):02}.jpg", quality=96)
    (ROOT / "private-crop-key.json").write_text(
        json.dumps([record for _, record in tiles], indent=2) + "\n"
    )
    chart = Image.open(ROOT / "v101a.jpg")
    references = Image.new("RGB", (428, 175), BG)
    for name, box, inset in (
        ("R1", (106, 420, 129, 445), 14), ("R2", (208, 38, 232, 65), 224),
    ):
        crop = fitted(chart.crop(box), 130, 126, 6.0)
        references.paste(crop, (inset+24, 20))
        ImageDraw.Draw(references).text((inset+73, 146), name, fill=INK)
    references.save(TARGET / "neutral-references.jpg", quality=96)
    print(f"{len(tiles)} anonymous cards across {(len(tiles) + 5)//6} sheets")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
scripts_as_text.prepare_supplementary_deck.py:
"""Prepare two separately frozen hand-two location recoveries."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import random

from PIL import Image

from prepare_blind_deck import BG, H, W, card, get_crop


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RECOVERED = {
    "pair-03": {
        "word_rect": [749, 731, 881, 818], "glyph_rect": [751, 770, 779, 799],
        "glyph_center": [764.6, 783.7], "word_box_id": "f40v.5.w2",
        "glyph_trust": "Allen letter with independently verified same-row word localization",
    },
    "pair-05": {
        "word_rect": [461, 619, 563, 706], "glyph_rect": [474, 647, 517, 682],
        "glyph_center": [495.5, 664.5], "word_box_id": "f55r.4 first or recovery",
        "glyph_trust": "companion row recovery and approximate native position near stain",
    },
}


def main():
    original = json.loads((ROOT / "geometry-with-row-recovery.json").read_text())
    newly_located = []
    for record in original:
        pair = record["pair_id"]
        if pair not in RECOVERED or record["symbol"] != "o":
            continue
        assert not record["available"]
        partner = next(r for r in original if r["pair_id"] == pair and r["symbol"] == "A")
        record.update(RECOVERED[pair])
        record.update({
            "available": True, "geometry_sensitivity": "secondary additions after fixed 30-card roster",
            "image": partner["image"], "iiif_image": partner["iiif_image"],
            "iiif_canvas": partner["iiif_canvas"], "letter_ordinal_1based": 1,
        })
        newly_located.append(record)
    random.Random(41287).shuffle(newly_located)
    assert len(newly_located) == 2
    board = Image.new("RGB", (2 * W, H), BG)
    staged = json.loads((ROOT / "private-crop-key.json").read_text())
    for idx, row in enumerate(newly_located):
        tile, key = card(row, f"X{31 + idx:02}", get_crop(row))
        board.paste(tile, (idx * W, 0))
        staged.append(key)
    board.save(ROOT / "blind-deck/board-06.jpg", quality=96)
    (ROOT / "private-combined-key.json").write_text(json.dumps(staged, indent=2) + "\n")
    (ROOT / "geometry-with-two-secondary.json").write_text(json.dumps(original, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
